title: ⏺️▶️ Qalibaf Departs for Baghdad at the Head of Parliamentary Delegation - Tehran – August 19, 2026
text:
⏺️▶️ Qalibaf Departs for Baghdad at the Head of Parliamentary Delegation - Tehran – August 19, 2026"

"Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, made remarks prior to his departure for Iraq, on Wednesday at the head of a high-ranking parliamentary delegation. "

"The visit aims to discuss regional developments, strengthen strategic cooperation between Tehran and Baghdad, and explore joint mechanisms to help establish stability and security in West Asia."

""
"- Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, Head of Iran's negotiating team and Parliament Speaker: "Today, at the invitation of the honorable Speaker of Iraq's Parliament, we are traveling to Baghdad with a parliamentary delegation, and during this trip, we will negotiate the most important issues, especially in the development of relations between the two countries in the economic, political, cultural, social, and security spheres.""

"- Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, Head of Iran's negotiating team and Parliament Speaker: "This trip is very important given that it takes place after the victory of the Islamic Republic of Iran in the imposed war during Ramadan [ US-Israel war against Iran] ; because in addition to being very important and fundamental for the development of bilateral relations, without a doubt, in the future of the region we will witness a new order, that the role of Iran and Iraq in the countries of the region and in Islamic countries will be very effective.""

"-Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, Head of Iran's negotiating team and Parliament Speaker: "A ceremony for this occasion [40th-Day Commemoration of Iran's Martyred leader] will also be held in Karbala, where I will attend on behalf of the Supreme Leader to deliver his message, his gratitude, and his greetings to the great nation of Iraq, who participated in both the funeral procession and this ceremony.
